conventions.tenancy: database per firm cell; no firm_id
conventions.ledger: trust.trust_transaction is the By-Law 9 book of record; TR-1500/TR-2500 derived; gl.* is operating only (CF-02)
conventions.gate_code: <module>.<slug> gate kind; spec id in spec_gate (RV2-001, CF-04)
conventions.rls: ENABLE + FORCE on every matter_id table except gate.approval_request, gl.journal_line (RV2-014)

retention_classes.RC-FIN: financial and trust records; min 10 years (By-Law 9, verify); never deleted
retention_classes.RC-AUDIT: audit/gates/access; life of cell + 10y (policy); never deleted
retention_classes.RC-ID: client ID records; 6y after later of end of retainer / last transaction (By-Law 7.1, verify)
retention_classes.RC-FILE: matter file content; firm policy per practice area, default 15y after close (Limitations Act, 2002 s.15 ultimate period, verify); legal hold overrides
retention_classes.RC-CONFLICT: conflict index (contacts, roles, checks); kept while firm operates
retention_classes.RC-LEAD: declined leads; 2y then reduce to sealed_prospect (policy, verify)
retention_classes.RC-PERM: rule packs and readiness records; permanent

classification_levels.P3: sensitive PI / secrets (encrypted or hashed at app layer)
classification_levels.P4: privileged / solicitor-client content (stored as encrypted object refs where possible)
